steps.text: Slaw first: red cabbage (90/95 g) and carrot (55/65 g) from Sunday, with yoghurt (35/45 g), the oil (9/13 g), lemon, mustard, salt and pepper. Leave it to sit.
Beef (72/85 g) into two loose balls. Do not season them. Do not compact them.
Heavy pan, dry, on high for a full 3 minutes. It has to be too hot.
Balls in, and immediately press flat and hard with a spatula for 10 seconds each. Salt the top. 90 seconds — no touching, no moving, no pressing again.
Scrape underneath with a firm edge to keep the crust attached, flip, cheddar on (16/25 g). 45 seconds.
Avocado (30/40 g) mashed on the base. Patties, lettuce (40/50 g), tomato (60/80 g), raw onion (30/40 g).

why: The crust is the whole dish, and it only forms in the first ninety seconds against a dry, screaming pan. Oil in the pan, salt on the raw side, or one early poke and you have lost it.
notes: D0-003: oil never appeared in this card's own step text — the why block explicitly says the patty pan must stay dry ('Oil in the pan... and you have lost it'). Placed at the slaw step instead, a raw dressing use alongside the yoghurt/lemon/mustard → olive_oil. Grams unchanged (9/13 g, matches table).
D0-014 (Sunday cabbage 515 g): this dish's red_cabbage (90/95 g) is one of the three consumers of Sunday's shred batch — see prep-a.json for the corrected 515 g / three-consumer fix.
